title: GPT-5.6
summary: GPT-5.6 represents OpenAI's latest language model release, featuring significant improvements in reasoning capabilities, multimodal processing, and agentic functionalities. The model demonstrates enhanced performance across coding, mathematics, and complex reasoning tasks compared to previous generations.
problem_solved: Advances AI capabilities for complex reasoning, coding, and multimodal tasks with improved accuracy and agentic functionality.
why_valuable: Provides state-of-the-art AI capabilities with enhanced reasoning and agent functions, enabling more sophisticated automation and problem-solving applications.
